generator: tools/blender/market_render.py + market_pack.py (v4.2.0.2 M1: the first shop's stall stages)

conventions.anchor: normalised [ax, ay] of the full untrimmed frame = world origin = footprint centre.
conventions.layers: <stage>_back = the whole stall (posts, shelf, signboard, step, counter); <stage>_front = only the counter and what stands on it (same frame + anchor). Draw back (depth d), the clerk at staffPoints[0] lifted by stepLiftPx (d + 0.5), front (d + 1).
conventions.points: every *Point(s) value is a px offset [dx, dy] from the sprite anchor (unscaled sprite).
conventions.staffPoints: the clerk's feet on the plank step, projected to the ground (z = 0); stepLiftPx = how far the sprite is drawn higher because the clerk stands on the step.
conventions.customerPoints: where the first customer of the line stands: diagonally front-left of the clerk, so the front customer does not stand between the camera and the clerk.
conventions.signQuad: the 4 corners [top-left, top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left] of the blank signboard face (it faces world -Y: the top edge slopes down to the right, 1 px down per 2 px across). The game writes the stage name (signText = a strings.js key) into it, sheared the same way.

market_s1_back.notes: Stage-1 food stall 「눈꽃 노점」 (v4.2.0.2): no awning, a blank wooden signboard on two back posts (top edge 2.6 m, the GAME writes the name into signQuad), a 0.6 m counter, a 12 cm plank step behind it. Draw market_s1_back (depth d), the clerk standing at staffPoints[0] lifted by stepLiftPx (d + 0.5), then market_s1_front (d + 1, same frame + anchor: only the counter and what stands on it). Goods-free: the real stock is the shelf pad's item tower.

market_s1_front.notes: Front layer of market_s1_back (same frame + anchor): the counter and what stands on it (object mask: only the builder's front layer). Draw it ABOVE the clerk (d + 1).
